_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with 3% rate of meaningful score moves and no single breaker; HOLD is the graded base-rate call until range or fear/funding breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current Anxiety and non-directional stance; narrative offers no competing forward call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC holds a ±1.5% 24h range and fear_greed stays 30-45 with funding near flat through next session
next_move.invalidated_if: fear_greed breaks under 25 with funding negative (down to Denial) or fear_greed above 50 on spot-led squeeze with etf_flows lifting off floor (up to Complacency)
